finding.claim: The kmctl check help text and the checks.py module summary line still say the command checks only indexes and prototypes; neither mentions the link check.

fixes.change: On an index line only the entry link the index check reports is skipped, so other links on that line (outside the folder, root-relative, or a second link) are checked; the module docstring names the link check.
The kmctl check help now says it checks that links resolve.
